description: Independent PIT version publication is missing from main; the old unmerged PR #6373 mixed the publisher with a v2-to-v3 default migration. non_goals: No database DDL/DML, PIT rebuild, activation, dataset/profile mutation, consumer/model changes, service/process control or experiments.
